title: Body-only 'Rev B': size ratio change on one colour, same quantities
subject: BWA-50817 Rev B – Coral size split
body:
Hi Karthik,

Rev B for BWA-50817: please change the Sunwashed Coral size split to S 300 / M 300 / L 400 / XL 200 (still 1,200 for that color). Heather Charcoal is unchanged and the order total stays 3,600 pcs.

Thanks,
Megan
Brightwater Apparel Inc.
